description: This file contains serializers (codecs) for floating-point and decimal types in the Orleans.Serialization framework, including FloatCodec, DoubleCodec, DecimalCodec, and conditionally compiled HalfCodec for .NET 6 or greater.

classes.name: FloatCodec
classes.description: Serializer for float values, implementing IFieldCodec<float>.

classes.name: DoubleCodec
classes.description: Serializer for double values, implementing IFieldCodec<double>.

classes.name: DecimalCodec
classes.description: Serializer for decimal values, implementing IFieldCodec<decimal>.

classes.name: HalfCodec
classes.description: Serializer for Half (16-bit floating point) values, conditionally compiled for .NET 6 or greater.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a float value with protocol framing.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a float value from the reader, handling different wire types.

methods.name: ReadFloatRaw
methods.description: Reads a float value without protocol framing.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a double value with protocol framing.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a double value from the reader, handling different wire types.

methods.name: ReadDoubleRaw
methods.description: Reads a double value without protocol framing.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a decimal value with protocol framing.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a decimal value from the reader, handling different wire types.

methods.name: ReadDecimalRaw
methods.description: Reads a decimal value without protocol framing.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a Half value with protocol framing (conditional).

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a Half value from the reader, handling different wire types (conditional).

methods.name: ReadHalfRaw
methods.description: Reads a Half value without protocol framing (conditional).
